newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ORTEGA SCORES TWICE ON DEBUT FOR VALENCIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ORTEGA SCORES TWICE ON DEBUT FOR VALENCIA.

text.p: Midfielder Ariel Ortega scored twice on his Spanish league debut as Valencia beat struggling Sevilla 4-2 on Saturday.

The Argentine international, who became Valencia's most costly signing earlier in the week, pounced on a loose ball to score just before halftime and sealed a fine performance by converting a penalty after being floored in the area in the dying minutes.
Valencia's other goals were scored by Brazilian striker Leandro and Jose Galvez.
Varsilis Tsartas and Jesus Galvan replied for Sevilla, who look condemned to a spell in the second division after losing three times in a week.
